results.feedback: The app crashes every time I upload a profile photo, and I have to restart it.
results.summary: The app crashes consistently when attempting to upload a profile photo, requiring a restart.
results.recommendation: Investigate and fix the bug related to profile photo uploads causing application crashes.

results.feedback: Customer support replied quickly and solved my billing issue. Great service!
results.summary: Customer received quick and effective support for a billing issue, resulting in praise for the service.
results.recommendation: Maintain the current efficient support workflow and acknowledge the team's performance.

results.feedback: Please add a dark mode so the app is more comfortable to use at night.
results.summary: Customer requested a dark mode feature for comfortable nighttime usage.
results.recommendation: Prioritize the development and implementation of a dark mode UI option.

results.feedback: The dashboard takes too long to load, and the login page sometimes freezes.
results.summary: The customer reported that the dashboard is slow to load and the login page freezes intermittently.
results.recommendation: Investigate and optimize dashboard load performance and resolve the intermittent freezing issue on the login page.

results.feedback: I love the new dashboard. It is clear, attractive, and easy to navigate.
results.summary: The customer loves the new dashboard, praising its clarity, attractiveness, and ease of navigation.
results.recommendation: Share the positive feedback with the design and development teams to acknowledge their successful work on the new dashboard.
